majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.headline: Your business already has personality. Q4 is the window to make every customer-facing touchpoint work harder.
majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.subhead: A low-cost, high-return revitalization concept for the festive trading window — preserve the place, sharpen the signal, and show visible CARBON° work quickly once scope and access are approved.
majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.visual_note: CARBON° preserves the earlier Majager's business-specific concept because recognizable real-business context makes the transformation easier to judge. AI-looking artefacts are refinement work, not a reason to throw away the concept. PLACE° direction is now locked: compact gazebo at the driveway edge, parallel with the street, operator faces right toward the existing social/covered area, normal driveway kept clear, no decorative trees.

visuals.title: Existing business → recognizable transformation
visuals.note: Use actual Majager's frontage/profile context wherever permission and asset rights allow.

visuals.title: PLACE° concept
visuals.note: Compact gazebo in the driveway, parallel with the street, facing toward the existing covered/social area; driveway remains usable; no decorative trees/planters.

visuals.title: SOCIAL° concept
visuals.note: A coherent Majager's social system: specials, events, branded promotions, responses and repeatable content rather than isolated artwork.

market_context.context: FNB/BER South African Consumer Confidence Index, Q3 2026: improved from Q2 but remains negative.
BER Other Services confidence in Q3 2026. BER says the next quarter looks brighter partly because of festive- and tourism-season boosts.
Stats SA's retail-seasonality example shows December accounted for 11% of 2019 annual retail sales across the sector — useful evidence of strong year-end seasonality, not a 2026 forecast.
One current public SA benchmark: one platform and eight posts per month from Social Media SA.
Sage reports 73% of surveyed South African SMBs invested in AI, while 47% use AI to drive revenue growth. Access alone is not the commercial result.

offer.title: 14-Day CARBON° Proof
offer.summary: A paid, tightly scoped proof period designed to show useful visible work before Majager's commits to a larger managed relationship.
offer.price_note: Proposed 14-day founding-partner activation. Not issued yet. The 24-hour quote clock starts only when CARBON° issues the final priced version.
